effect_text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait trait and 1 yellow Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If the total cards in both players' security stacks is 6 or less, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
